title: Things worth a look
intro: While checking each workflow against the code, these gaps came up. None of them breaks a journey, but each is a product decision you may want to make. The section and workflow where each appears is given in brackets.
items: A lot made private keeps its waiting reservation requests, and the owner can still accept one.
Donor building owner, List a lot
When the owner declines a reservation, the architect is not notified; it only shows in project activity. The consultant gets no reservation notifications at all.
Client, Seller decision; Donor building owner, Decide reservation requests
When another buyer reserves a lot, the approved material drops out of the client's Approvals and Reservations with no prompt to choose again.
Client, Seller decision
Once saved, a captured item's material, size and quantity cannot be changed and the item cannot be deleted. Undo straight after saving is the only fix.
Surveyor, Capture an item
A result the consultant enters for a goal cannot be removed from the screen, only replaced.
Sustainability consultant, Enter a result
The client cannot send a circular economy statement back to the consultant, only comment and mark it reviewed.
Sustainability consultant, Statement review

An owner cannot claim a building a surveyor added from its own side. The two records join only when the surveyor asks the owner to confirm it, or moves her captures into the owner's record once appointed.
Surveyor, Move early captures into an appointment
Waste engagements exist only in the sample data. Nothing in the platform starts a new one.
How it fits together, Getting a new organisation started
Removing a surveyor or a deconstruction contractor tells nobody; only the building's activity records it.
Donor building owner, Appoint a surveyor; Contractor dates
A share link page hides every reserved lot, including one reserved for the opener's own project.
Donor building owner, Open a share link
Search shows inventory results to a deconstruction contractor that then open a no-access page.
Accounts and the sandbox, Search

Sandbox limits, expected for now: Reset your password lets anyone who knows an account's email set its password; invite links only work in the same browser; changing a sample account's password stops its one-click card working until the sandbox is reset.
Accounts and the sandbox
